svg.title: A 6-year tree, 8373 commits, 7 lanterns for code reviews.
svg.desc: A bonsai grown from the public GitHub history of maintainer, drawn for 2026-01-20. Season: winter. Weather: overcast. Maturity level 7 of 13, in a antique pot. Plaques on the pot rim: commits1k, prs100. Every element is recomputable from public history; nothing here is random or purchasable.
